summary: A network playbook (first_playbook.yml) sets connection ansible.netcommon.network_cli, hosts all and gather_facts false, uses vyos.vyos.vyos_facts with gather_subset all and a debug task printing ansible_net_hostname and ansible_net_version; gathered facts are kept in memory for later tasks.
questions: Why is gather_facts false in network playbooks?
How do I print a network device's hostname with Ansible?
How do I set connection network_cli in a playbook?
